qs.q: Total Air Temp is always... than Static Air Temp and the difference varies with...
Cruising at FL390, M.84 is found to give a TAS of 499kt. The ISA deviation at this level will be:
qs.ex: LSS = 499 ÷ 0.84 ≈ 594 kt → T = (594/39)² ≈ 232 K ≈ −41 °C. ISA at FL390 is −56.5 °C, so the air is about ISA +15.5. The book key prints (b) −19; corrected to (a) — a TAS this high for M0.84 can only mean warmer than ISA.

qs.q: Total air temperature is ____ than ____ by an amount proportional to ____
A temperature sensor having a recovery factor of 0.75 indicates 30° C. Static Air Temperature (SAT) is 25° C. How high is the Ram-rise?
qs.ex: Ram rise measured = 30 − 25 = 5 °C at recovery 0.75 → full ram rise = 5 / 0.75 ≈ 6.7 °C. Book key: (b) 5 °C (the indicated rise).

Even if the CAS or MN is unaltered on purpose the MN may change due to a change in the OAT, eg. high temperature to low temperature, the LSS will decrease, thus to maintain a constant MN the TAS must decrease.
